toolchain.name: elvm
toolchain.role: EsoLangVM — EIR parser + target/hell (HeLL backend) + libc
toolchain.backend_note: HeLL is HeLL assembly for Malbolge/Unshackled; won't be tested by default — HELL=1 make hell, adjust tools/runhell.sh, ASCII-only I/O

toolchain.name: 8cc
toolchain.role: C frontend → ELVM IR (EIR). Harvard, 6 regs A,B,C,D,SP,BP; ops mov/add/sub/load/store/setcc/jcc/putc/getc/exit; 24-bit words

toolchain.name: LMFAO
toolchain.role: HeLL assembler → Malbolge Unshackled (.mu). Used by ELVM target/hell pipeline

toolchain.name: Unshackled.c
toolchain.version: Unshackled.c (C reference, max rotation width UINTMAX_MAX)
toolchain.role: Malbolge Unshackled interpreter (C, fast) — reference VM for TARGET_A
toolchain.alt: Unshackled-20.c (fixed 20 trits, faster for low-width programs like brainfuck)

toolchain.name: Unshackled.hs
toolchain.role: Reference interpreter for Unshackled — spec truth

provenance.prior_art_search: 2026-09-01 web search: ELVM HeLL, Malbolge Unshackled Turing-complete, Doom Malbolge — NO PRIOR MALBOLGE DOOM PORT FOUND IN INITIAL SEARCH

memory_model.unshackled: unbounded trits, dynamic rotation width ≥10, Turing-complete (brainfuck + MalbolgeLisp 2020)

io_notes.unshackled: Unicode codepoints, ...21 = newline, ...22 = EOF; ELVM backend reverts newlines + mod 256 but limit to ASCII
